statement_blocker: The catalog supplies no spaces, scalar field, operator or variational form, trial/test subspaces, continuous or discrete equation, continuity/coercivity/symmetry assumptions, exact-arithmetic boundary, ordered binders, or conclusion. Galerkin orthogonality, best approximation, discrete solvability, Cea quasi-optimality, and convergence are inequivalent propositions; selecting one at intake would invent or substitute mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix real or complex scalars; vector, Hilbert, Sobolev, or energy spaces; the continuous, trial, and test spaces; universes; and all topology, norm, inner-product, and typeclass context.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose Galerkin orthogonality, projection or best approximation, continuous/discrete existence and uniqueness, Cea quasi-optimality, convergence, an error rate, or application-specific correctness.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every zero-space, subspace, form, constant, solution, approximation-family, complex-orientation, and numerical boundary listed in scope-map.md.
